source: North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services, Vital Records: North Dakota Vital Event Summary 1998-2024, 'North Dakota Leading Causes of Death, Number of Events <year>' (county of residence)
note: North Dakota residents by county of residence (53 counties), from the 'North Dakota Leading Causes of Death, Number of Events <year>' table of the North Dakota Vital Event Summary, one PDF per year 1998-2024 (27 files, 22,596,817 bytes, downloaded 2026-10-15 with the owner's yes from hhs.nd.gov; addresses and SHA-256 in sources/nd_hhs/SOURCES.tsv; table page 6-9 depending on year; read with pdftotext -layout by scripts/nd_parse.py, values placed by column position). Small numbers: 1998-2000 print every count; from 2001 the report's own rule applies: 'events that occur 5 or less times within a given category, will be not be reported. The value will be listed as NR' (zeros print as 0). NR cells are listed under masked_1_5 and never turned into numbers; nothing is derived from the reports' crude-rate pages. Three blank cells in 1998 (Divide accidents, Eddy COPD, Slope suicide) are left out. Checks: where a column has no NR, the 53 county values add exactly to the printed Total row (all columns, all years); where NR occurs, Total minus the shown values lies between 1 and 5 per NR cell, except 2006, 2007 and 2023, whose Total row equals the sum of the shown values only. Causes kept: all causes, heart (I00-I09, I11, I13, I20-I51), cancer (C00-C97), stroke (I60-I69), COPD (J40-J47, stored as clrd), Alzheimer's (2003 on), diabetes, influenza/pneumonia (J10-J18), cirrhosis (K70, K73-K74, stored as liver), suicide, kidney (some years), COVID-19 (2020 on); raw: accidental, other arteries, atherosclerosis, hypertension, childhood columns (1998-2001). Against CDC: all deaths 99.3%, cancer 97.5%, CLRD 96.3%, heart 95.5%, suicide 92.4% pass; Alzheimer's (ND runs about 8% above CDC), stroke 89.1%, diabetes 89.0%, COVID 89.1%, liver 83.3%, flu and pneumonia 79.3%, kidney (14 checked) fail. About 907 CDC-hidden cells would fill (from 2001 only counts of 6-9). Terms: none stated in the reports; none_stated. Staged 2026-10-15, not approved.
